translations.english: Two of them saw the ground covered with Vanaras of mountainlike forms, who had fallen with tails cut off, some with broken thighs, broken legs and fingers, necks severed, letting off blood, discharging urine and glowing weapons lying on the ground.
translations.hindi: किन्तु त्रिशिरा ने विषधर सर्प के समान तेज़ बाणों से उस वृक्ष को काट गिराया । वक्ष को कटा हुआ देख, अङ्गद उछले ७ स ववष ततो वक्षाजशलांश्च कपिकुञ्जरः न तान्‌ प्रचिच्छेद संक्रद्धखिशिरा निशितः शर!
